name: Tartan Sett
desc: A real tartan sett — a symmetric thread-count stripe sequence run in both warp and weft and interlaced in 2/2 twill, so the crossings blend optically and a 45-degree wale runs through the cloth, round wool threads catching a soft sheen as the bolt scrolls.

density.doc: number of stripes in the sett

style.doc: palette+treatment: sombre military / bright festive red / earthy hunting / graphic monochrome dress / washed antique
